pragma.purpose:
Bounded float pressure-reduction SIMD experiment on copied full API sources.

Only observer summation order may change. No global fast math, FMA, OpenMP
runtime, port-velocity reassociation, mechanical update or mode cut is allowed.
pragma.allowed_difference: Only float pressure reduction summation order in Modes::portImpulseRadiation/radiation; all updates/port/contact/bridge arithmetic keep their original expressions and order.
pragma.timing_scope: Three paired trials AB,BA,AB using the existing actual-API three-case schedules. Callback thread CPU includes event dispatch, process and identical raw-pressure capture; excludes checkpoint serialization/prepare/audio writes. Snapshot copies expose private members solely for diagnostic access; layout is unchanged.
pragma.snapshot_scope: At frames64,512,4096,8192,andfinal for each case: all string q/p/damp, string velocity/force, board q/p/force, hammer position/velocity/age/hardness/contact/damper state, pedal, solver counters, all controller states/RNG/recovery and mechanical source x/v. No struct padding is serialized. Observer caches, output high-pass/filter state and pressure are intentionally excluded.
pragma.limits: Shared Linux GCC host only; OpenMP SIMD compiler support in SDK is untested. No global fast math/FMA/OpenMP runtime, auditory/inaudibility claim, scalar fallback replacement or canonical adoption.
pragma.decision: Reject: actual fused pressure loop not vectorized; all nine paired timings slower by 2.4–4.0% in case medians. Pressure and mechanics remain byte-identical.

analysis_revision.reason: Promote float32 samples to float64 for RMS/spectral/stereo calculations; no output samples or timing rerun/changed.
